name: Scriptures The
overview: The Scriptures, as revealed in the sample verses, are divinely given words that God commands His people to obey and preserve without alteration, as seen in Exodus and Deuteronomy. They serve as a foundation for righteous living and faithful possession of the land, emphasizing the importance of internalizing God's statutes and judgments. These passages highlight the Scriptures as a trustworthy guide that believers are to cherish, teach, and uphold, reflecting their vital role in shaping obedience and devotion to the Lord.
